snippet.title: I Made a Rhythm Game That Uses Your Entire Keyboard
snippet.description:
I built Rhythm Typer, a typing rhythm game that uses your entire keyboard.

Play Rhythm Typer: https://rhythmtyper.net (or https://rhythm-typer.web.app)
Join the discord: https://discord.gg/dngwPYzGDf

In this video, I show the journey of creating Rhythm Typer from a school project, to a Reddit post that unexpectedly took off, to an online game with community made maps, a ranking system, and more. This project took a lot longer than expected, and I’m super excited to finally share it. If you enjoyed the video, consider subscribing!

Music:
stream cafe - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TQvXEza4fPc&t=4s
Helynt - Continue
Lukrembo - Onion
shushubobo - coffee time
Alge - good for the ghost

#rhythmgame #osu #typing #keyboard #gamedev
